prompt: One museum collection (department) as a tile with a real cover work, linking to its collection page.
shortDesc: One collection (museum department) as a tile: a real representative work framed uncropped on a 4:3 mat, the collection name and the museum, linking to /collections/<collection-id>. g-collection-list renders these for you; write one by hand only for a few hand-picked collections inside g-grid, copying values from a ListDepartments entry: collection-id="met-11" or "aic-PC-10", name="European Paintings", museum="The Met" or "Art Institute of Chicago" (optional, derived from the id prefix), image-url = coverImageUrl, which starts with /__art/ (optional; never a generated /images/ URL, without it the tile is typographic).

props.name: collection-id
props.description: Department id from ListDepartments, e.g. met-11 or aic-PC-10. The tile links to /collections/<collection-id>.

props.name: museum
props.description: "Art Institute of Chicago" or "The Met". Defaults from the id prefix (aic-/met-).

props.name: image-url
props.description: coverImageUrl from ListDepartments (/__art/…). Anything that isn't a /__art/ URL is ignored. Without it the mat shows the name typographically.

styling.tailwindClasses: flex flex-col h-full no-underline; mat: aspect-[4/3] grid place-items-center bg-stone-200 rounded-sm; caption: grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] gap-x-3 pt-3
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. The cover sits uncropped (object-fit contain, 7% padding, soft drop-shadow) on a --mat 4:3 box, lazy-loaded and faded in; the mat pulses gently while it loads. No image or a failed image shows the name in italic Newsreader --soft (with a gilt hairline) or the honest 'Image unavailable' placeholder, never a generated picture. Name in Newsreader 500 20px, museum in the .label small caps. Hover/focus-visible: 1px gilt inset on the mat, oxblood underline on the name, a -2px lift and an oxblood '→' sliding in 4px; static under prefers-reduced-motion. Fills its grid cell height (:host height 100%).
